svg.title: Provenance tags lead into the investigation folder
svg.desc: Attach different provenance tags to every card before the investigation folder. Methodological differences remain visible as the story turns toward how findings were produced.

**Caption:**
> THE NEXT QUESTION IS NOT ONLY WHAT THE AGENTS DID.
>
> IT IS HOW ANYONE DECIDED WHAT THE RECORD MEANS.
